diagrams.title: **Agentic RAG in action
diagrams.caption: **Agentic RAG in action.** The agent uses RAG for history, an API for live data and memory for this user, then reasons over all three. The answer is personal because the agent decided what to look up, not because someone scripted it.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **Plan, act, reason, repeat
diagrams.caption: **Plan, act, reason, repeat.** A chatbot stops after one answer. An agent goes round this loop as many times as the task needs.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 400" aria-label="The agent cycle: plan, then act, then reason about the results, then plan again, repeating until the goal is reached." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

        <text x="500" y="92" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">break the goal into tasks</text>

        <text x="790" y="310" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">2  Act</text>
        <text x="790" y="340" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">use tools and knowledge</text>

        <text x="210" y="310" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">3  Reason</text>
        <text x="210" y="340" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">check results, adjust plan</text>

diagrams.title: **The agent is the coordinator, not the brain
diagrams.caption: **The agent is the coordinator, not the brain.** The LLM does the thinking; the agent passes messages between the user, the LLM, the tools and memory, and keeps the plan moving.

diagrams.title: **Three tiers, one trade-off
diagrams.caption: **Three tiers, one trade-off.** Going down the stack you gain control and pay for it in effort. This course lives in the middle tier: Amazon Bedrock for models and safety features, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore for running agents in production.
diagrams.svg:

Top: agentic applications, ready to use, such as Amazon Q Business, Amazon Q Developer, Amazon Quick Suite and Kiro. diagrams.title: **One front door, many models
diagrams.caption: **One front door, many models.** Your agent code never changes when you change models. And if you customise a model in SageMaker AI, Custom Model Import brings it into Bedrock so it can be your agent's brain too.
